behavioral_notes.observation: hr.employee overrides _search, fetch, search_fetch, get_view and get_formview_id/action: when the user lacks hr.group_hr_user, reads are transparently rerouted to the hr.employee.public model (which exposes only non-private fields like name, job, department, work email). Private fields carry groups='hr.group_hr_user'; _check_private_fields raises AccessError if a non-HR user reads them. This dual-model confidentiality is invisible in metadata.

user_id is related to resource_id.user_id. action_create_user / action_create_users / action_create_users_confirmation create res.users records from employees (login=work_email, partner=work_contact_id); _sync_user copies partner, image and tz between user and employee; create()/write() keep work_contact_id and res.partner in sync. A unique (user_id, company_id) SQL constraint forbids one user being two employees in a company.

parent_id/child_ids build the manager hierarchy (Many2one self-relation, tracked). hr.department.write() with a new manager_id calls _update_employee_manager to reassign parent_id of all department members; get_department_hierarchy feeds the OWL DepartmentChart org-chart widget. parent_path/_parent_store gives recursive department nesting.

hr.employee delegates ~64 fields (job, department, wage, contract dates, address) to hr.version via _inherits. create_version/create_contract snapshot a new dated version; current_version_id is computed by date and a cron (_cron_update_current_version_id) keeps it current. Edits to inherited fields are routed to version_id.write in employee.write and chatter-logged.

Archiving an employee empties dangling manager/coach links, then opens the hr.departure.wizard (reason/date). Cron notify_expiring_contract_work_permit schedules mail.activity reminders before contract/work-permit expiry. Department membership also auto-subscribes the user to discuss.channel via subscription_department_ids.

36 JS files, 6 OWL components (DepartmentChart org-chart, HrPresenceStatus, HrEmployeeChat, Many2OneAvatarEmployeeField + kanban variant, ButtonNewContractWidget); ~24 registry registrations (avatar-employee fields, presence-status widgets, versions_timeline, work_permit_upload) and 7 patches (AvatarCardPopover, ResPartner, ResUsers, Store). Asset bundles include web.assets_backend and mail.assets_public.

classification.rationale: hr is the Human Resource Management support activity of Porter's value chain (Stabell & Fjeldstad: a support value configuration, not a primary chain/shop/network flow). It maintains the employee/department/job master data and version history that every operational module consumes; it does not itself convert demand into a delivered product. APQC PCF category 7.0 Develop and Manage Human Capital covers exactly this: workforce master data, organization structure and job positions.

standard_capabilities: employee master records with private/public confidentiality split
department hierarchy + org-chart widget and manager cascade
user account creation & res.partner work-contact sync
presence indicators, onboarding plans, departure wizard, expiry crons
typical_fits: centralized HR directory feeding payroll/attendance/time-off bridge modules
two-tier HR security (officer vs manager) with own-document record rules
common_gaps: custom employee_properties beyond the generic Properties field
